system.description:
Warcasters rarely begin their training in elite academies and instead learn of their basic magical talent during childhood. At 1st level, choose one of the following initiation methods. This will determine your spellcasting modifier and also provide you with two cantrips that do not count against your list of cantrips granted by this class.

Adventurers

Whether you are the child of adventurers or simply learned a few tricks from adventurers moving through your community, you learned to cast the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.uy8he1yquaiym6y8]{Prestidigitation} and @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.mocigztrqyoks506]{Mage Hand} cantrips through watching their actions. Your spellcasting ability is Intelligence.

Circus Folk

You may have grown up in the circus or simply spent time around many entertainers in your youth. You learned to cast the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.4oruofw2q7gso9hq]{Minor Illusion} and @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.ohrkuqnbaeutcwox]{Vicious Mockery} cantrips through imitating the flair of those around you. Your spellcasting ability is Charisma.

Eldritch Encounter

Touched by things that should not be within this world, or exposed to words of power not meant for mortal minds, you were irrevocably changed by the experience. You learned to cast the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.kh26gom04osoo005]{Dancing Lights} and @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.wb05jikqneh34h1s]{Pestilence} cantrips. Your spellcasting ability is Charisma.

Hedge Witch

Whether trained by an actual hedge witch or taken by the fey, your magics hold the bent of nature magic rather than pure arcana. You learned to cast the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.5o1rvwzxmsh5ji9i]{Druidcraft} and @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.krg2pw9p0pa5praw]{Produce Flame} cantrips. Your spellcasting ability is Intelligence.

Priesthood

While you may not be a priest, yourself, you still gained insight into the basics of cantrip casting in a monastery, temple, or similar setting. You learned to cast the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.tvtm60k5wxyki9qc]{Sacred Flame} and @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.omvngnmoo75is54f]{Spare the Dying} cantrips. Your spellcasting ability is Charisma.

Scholastics

You began your path to the warcaster in careful study, whether in a school or under a singular mentor, and you learned to cast the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.bqavvq6ju5ti8hr3]{Light} and @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.4gcxix2l4zvy9kdu]{Message} cantrips. Your spellcasting ability is Intelligence.

Unholy Power

Exposed to necromantic magics from a young age, you may be scarred by their touch or simply so soaked by their power that it wells up from within. You learned to cast the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.bpkked98u8mb2q3w]{Chill Touch} and @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.eiek2vbzwijd0qac]{Thaumaturgy} cantrips. Your spellcasting ability is Charisma.

Warmaster

The quintessential warcaster, you learned your abilities from combat casters, often on battlefields or training grounds of military units. You learned to cast the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.okqhwebhlb89crxe]{Arcane Muscles} and @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.c1qq11be32b3s1qr]{Fire Bolt} cantrips. Your spellcasting ability is Intelligence.
